seo.title: Enjoy 7 Days 6 Nights Tour of Assam and Meghalaya - Kajaawa
seo.description: Explore the most beautiful places like Cherrapunjee, Dawki, Mawlynnong, Jowai, Guwahati and Shillong at the best price offered by Kajaawa

main.title: Package Includes
items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast
Camping
Sightseeing

content.text: Wonderful package for wonderful people. This is the best opportunity to visit the two of the most popular states of Northeast together. Meghalaya being the abode of clouds literally keeps up to its name. Its mesmerizing scenic beauties are enough to prove why tourists love to visit this place. Assam on the other hand, is heritage wise considered to be one of the richest among all.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Mesmerise yourself with the beauty of the two northeastern states
Adventure at the famous tourist spots like Cherrapunji, Dawki, Mawlynnong etc
Have a local sightseeing at Guwahati.

main.title: Mesmerizing Assam and Meghalaya Tour Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati
items: Start your refreshing journey from Guwahati by driving to Shillong.
Enroute stop and enjoy the mesmerizing view of Umiam Lake.
Check in to your hotel and if there’s time, visit Ward's Lake.

days.title: Day 2 : Travel to Cherrapunjee
items: Wake up at the beautiful hill station and drive ahead to Cherrapunji.
Reach Cherrapunji and visit Mawkdok Dympep Valley and Nohkalikai Falls.
Visit Seven Sisters Falls, Mawsmai Cave, Arwah Cave and Eco Park.

days.title: Day 3 : Dawki and Mawlynnong Tour
items: Wake up amidst the beautiful greenery all around.
Head to the cleanest village of Asia, Mawlynnong and explore its surroundings.
Also visit the astounding Single Living Root Bridge and the Balancing Rock.
Have a wonderful view of Bangladesh plains from the Tree House.
Later drive to Dawki and visit the clean and clear Umngot River.
Also visit the India Bangladesh border in Tamabil.
Later head to the campsite at Shnongpdeng.

days.title: Day 4 : Jowai Tour
items: Wake up in the morning and after breakfast get ready for the tour to your next destination.
Visit one of the largest waterfalls of Meghalaya, Krang Suri Waterfalls
Visit Tyrshi Falls and Phe Phe Falls.
Admire the high mountains and steep valleys on the way.

days.title: Day 5 : Shillong Sightseeing and travel to Guwahati
items: After breakfast tart your journey to the beautiful places in Shillong
Visit Lady Hydari Park, Ward's Lake and Don Bosco Museum.
Later drive to Guwahati and evening is free at leisure.
Overnight stay in Guwahati

days.title: Day 6 : Enjoy the sightseeing in Guwahati
items: Visit Assam State Zoo and Assam State Museum.
Go for a cruise at the mighty Brahmaputra River (at your own cost).
Enjoy the beautiful sunset view at the Brahmaputra River.

days.title: Day 7 : Departure
items: In the morning after breakfast pack your bags with loads of memories of your Assam and Meghalaya Tour.
We will drop you at Guwahati Airport/Railway station for your onward journey.

items.text: No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
